title: Estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate (eGFR) Calculators
text: egfr vectorised R toolkit estimating glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) creatinine clearance serum creatinine, cystatin C, . implements 20 validated adult, paediatric, neonatal equations, plus helpers body surface area, KDIGO CKD staging, unit conversion. package inspired kidney.epi package ported equation set used eGFR.app. equations screening tools substitute measured GFR clinical judgement.

title: Estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate (eGFR) Calculators
code: library(egfr)  # CKD-EPI 2021 creatinine (race-free) — recommended for adults egfr_ckdepi_cr_2021(creatinine = 1.0, age = 50, sex = "female") #> 68.6  # Fully vectorised: pass vectors for any argument egfr_ckdepi_cr_2021(   creatinine = c(0.8, 1.2, 1.5),   age        = c(40, 65, 72),   sex        = c("female", "male", "female") )  # Units: supply creatinine in umol/L instead of mg/dL egfr_ckdepi_cr_2021(88.4, 50, "female", creatinine_units = "umol/l")  # Classify the result into a KDIGO stage ckd_stage(egfr_ckdepi_cr_2021(1.0, 50, "female")) #> "G2"

title: Estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate (eGFR) Calculators
text: egfr_*() functions return unrounded values mL/min/1.73m^2, except egfr_cockcroft_gault(), returns creatinine clearance mL/min. Creatinine defaults mg/dL; pass creatinine_units = "umol/l" use SI units. Height defaults cm. Sex labels default "male"/"female" can customised via label_sex_male / label_sex_female.

title: CKD-EPI 2009 creatinine eGFR (with race coefficient) — egfr_ckdepi_cr_2009
text: creatinine Numeric vector serum creatinine. age Numeric vector age years. sex Vector sex labels (see label_sex_male/label_sex_female). ethnicity Optional vector ethnicity labels.
